verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI has a dedicated 'durable execution' docs page stating agents can preserve progress across transient failures and restarts, and the marketing copy explicitly mentions running 'on a durable background queue,' indicating native support or integrations for durable execution. However, the evidence pack shows only high-level doc titles/snippets with no detail on which durable-execution engines (e.g., Temporal, DBOS) are integrated, no hands-on validation of surviving actual process restarts/deploys, and no community corroboration of this specific capability. Missing for 10: named durable-execution integration partners/specifics, independent or hands-on verification of restart/deploy durability, and detail on state persistence mechanics.
